import pandas as pd

messy = pd.read_csv("orders_messy.csv")

messy["customer"] = messy["customer"].str.strip()
messy["country"] = messy["country"].str.strip().str.title()
messy["channel"] = messy["channel"].str.replace(" ", "_").fillna("unknown")
messy["first_name"] = messy["customer"].str.split(" ").str[0]

desk_lines = messy["product"].str.contains("desk", case=False).sum()
print(messy["country"].value_counts())
